current_events: The Israeli military raids 15 cities in the occupied West Bank, arresting several Palestinians, forcing over 2,000 from their homes, and destroying a three-storey building in Hebron
Unknown gunmen attack a village in Taraba State, Nigeria, killing at least ten people. Locals place the death toll at 20, while Amnesty International claims at least 40
At least one person is killed and 527 others are injured as Typhoon Champi swept near Taiwan
Six people are killed and another is injured when a passenger train collides with a minibus in Jewish Autonomous Oblast, Russia
Two people are killed and over 2,000 others are displaced by flooding in Chaco and Corrientes, Argentina

Survivors of sexual abuse by Catholic clergy reach a settlement with the Archdiocese of New York in the United States, which will see the archdiocese paying at least $250,000 to around 1,300 plaintiffs, totaling over $800 million
Catholic Church sex abuse cases in the United States
Two people succumb to their injuries sustained the day before during a mass shooting at a Greek Orthodox Church in Karak Governorate, Jordan, bringing the toll to nine killed and 40 injured
Five people are killed and three more injured in a suspected gang-related mass shooting at a residence in Lavender Hill, Cape Flats, Western Cape, South Africa
The Yellow vests hold a second wave of mass demonstrations across France. About 410,000 people participate and over 1,000 people are arrested
About 110,000 protesters march in Paris, France
Rioters in Paris attack police with projectiles, but are dispersed with tear gas and water cannons. A gendarmerie helicopter is deployed to locate remaining rioters
Party leader Marine Le Pen holds the National Rally congress in Orléans, France. Protesters, including left-wing politicians, marched in opposition
A new wave of protests is held across Italy. Clashes are reported in Bologna, Turin, Rome and Florence. Protests are also held in Milan, Naples, Padua and Bari
Anti-government protests break out in Tirana, Albania. Various government buildings are attacked
A student protest in Barcelona, Spain, ends in riots, looting and clashes with the police
At least 25,000 people gather in Madrid, Spain, in support of the country's state pension fund as it could significantly weaken following the general election in November
Thousands of Israelis rally in Hostages Square in Tel Aviv to protest against the government, prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet, and the continuation of the Gaza war
